card.name: Inside book and article titles
card.fires_on: A word in the middle of a book or article title, usually just after a colon, subtitle start or 'and'/'of', in citations and bibliographies. It also fires on some words inside quoted or biblical phrases.

modes.label: Subtitle words in citations
modes.description: Content words partway through a cited book title, before the rest of the title continues.
modes.example: Erez Manela, The Wilsonian Moment: Self-D<<etermination>> and the International Origins of Anticolonial

modes.label: Words in quoted phrases
modes.description: A noun or verb inside a quoted or scripture-like phrase that continues after it.
modes.example: By wisdom the Lord laid the foundation of the<< earth>>; he established the heavens by understanding.

card.plain: It lights up on words in the middle of a book title in a reference list, where the title keeps going.
